name: PUBG 2.0
desc:
🔥 NEW WEAPON UNLOCKS & PROGRESSION 🔥
Prove your skill to unlock elite firepower! Grind your way to the top with these kill milestones:
🎯 Crossbow: 1,000 Total Kills
💥 Grenade Launcher: 5,000 Total Kills
⚡ Rail Gun: 10,000 Total Kills

🎒 PERSISTENT INVENTORY
Your loot and loadout now save between sessions. Drag & drop items in the custom hotbar to organize your gear.
CONTROLS: Q (PC), Top-Left Backpack Icon (Mobile), & Console Supported.

🏆 HALL OF FAME
Support development? Check the Donation Board in the plane to see featured supporters.

📢 ALPHA STATUS
We are still in early Alpha! Report bugs via our community links.
Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ to help us reach the next update goal!
